reference: Current Worklife desktop screenshot; concept images with labeled demonstration data

images.title: 1 — Минимальный графит
images.direction: Direction 01: Quiet graphite workspace. A refined, restrained professional tool. Narrow full-height text navigation on the left; one broad flat activity ledger in the center; a very compact contextual market/result rail on the right. Neutral charcoal #202124, slightly elevated #292c30 surfaces, muted steel-blue accent. Most activity is separated by fine rules rather than floating cards. One clear page title and a compact toolbar. Small thoughtful status chips, disciplined 8px spacing, medium information density. Feel mature, precise and unusually calm; generous margins without an empty half-screen.
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the supplied screenshot of the existing Worklife desktop application into one polished, buildable modern UI reference. Preserve the product identity and Russian language, but substantially redesign its visual composition. This is a visual concept based on an existing application, not a phone mockup, landing page or illustration.
Product: a local desktop browser monitor/settings for an external MCP job-search agent. The user talks to their own agent; this UI shows real work, results and market context. Shared data concerns EMPLOYERS ONLY. Standard HeroUI-like components, clean sans serif, restrained rounding, thin separators and precise spacing. Dark, low-glare surfaces, soft gray text, readable contrast, calm accent; no bright white, pure black, neon, gradients, glass blobs, giant promotional headings, avatars or decorative charts.
Canvas: flat full-screen desktop UI, landscape around 1600x1000. Crisp legible Russian labels. No device frame or camera perspective. Small visible label "Концепт · демоданные".
Information to include thoughtfully, without repeating explanations: brand "Worklife"; navigation "Обзор", "Рынок", "Вакансии", "Работодатели", "Расписание", "Материалы", "Настройки". Primary content is a compact activity history with four sample records: "Изучены источники вакансий", "Сохранены 3 вакансии", "Подготовлен CV на английском", "Обновлены сведения о компании". Small times and states, one contextual "Подробнее" action per relevant row. Include a modest market summary with exact labels "Медиана предложений", "180 000 ₽", "Москва · RUB/мес · до налогов", "18 вакансий с зарплатой"; these are explicitly demo numbers, not market claims. Saved results and one next scheduled search may be secondary. No mandatory model setup or goal input. Prioritize a coherent hierarchy and the user's task over adding widgets.

images.title: 2 — Трёхколоночный монитор
images.direction: Direction 02: Master-detail operations monitor. Deliberate three-pane desktop composition: compact left navigation, middle chronological activity list, and a larger persistent selected-result inspector on the right. The selected activity is "Сохранены 3 вакансии"; inspector shows three concise vacancy rows with employer, salary range, format and source, all clearly demo content. Put the salary-market comparison in the inspector as a small factual strip. Top contextual tab strip "Активность / Результаты". Cool dark slate, muted powder-blue selection, minimal rounded cards. Excellent horizontal alignment and a clear visual relationship between selection and details. No extra promotional text.

images.title: 3 — Тёплый графит
images.direction: Direction 03: Warm graphite editorial workspace. Replace the permanent left sidebar with an elegant compact top navigation and a secondary section menu. Main content is two coordinated columns: wide activity ledger and narrower market/scheduled-work column. Warm charcoal #292725, warm gray surfaces, soft stone text, tiny subdued amber accents for selected tabs and key actions. Editorial alignment, calm typography, thin warm-gray rules. Useful density and polished asymmetric proportions, no enormous headings or newspaper ornament. Make this visibly different in navigation and spatial rhythm from a conventional sidebar dashboard.

images.title: 4 — Рабочая консоль
images.direction: Direction 04: Precision console for a frequent desktop user. Compact two-level toolbar and a slim collapsible side navigation. A full-width structured activity table is the main surface, with a small market summary band above it and a lower split area for saved vacancies and next scheduled work. Visually meticulous columns, row rhythm, functional filters, understated native controls. Charcoal and neutral gray with muted cyan-blue accent only on active controls. Monospace only for timestamps or tiny tool identifiers, normal sans serif for all meaningful text. A professional operations console, not a terminal, not a finance trading dashboard. No decorative charts, no overcrowding.

images.title: 5 — Мягкие панели
images.direction: Direction 05: Soft, composed workspace with sage accents. A short full-height sidebar with four main destinations; remaining destinations behind small expandable groups. Main area uses two or three carefully sized native-looking panels, not a wall of equal KPI tiles. An activity panel with compact human-readable rows, a useful market panel with the stated demo median and sample basis, and an understated upcoming-search strip. Soft neutral graphite surfaces, muted sage selected-state accents, low-glare gray typography. Slightly more breathing room and gentle surface layering than the other directions; exceptionally clear grouping and consistent alignment. No oversized latest-action hero card.
